svg.text: No token -> 401 + resource_metadata; client reads the discovery documents; authenticates at Keycloak (3); retries with the JWT

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Gateway: signature, issuer, audience, expiry; needs a role (403 without); per-tool rule hides tools the role may not use

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Gateway -> server with its OWN Google ID token (audience = that one server), never the caller's token; the server verifies it

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each server reaches its Google service as its own Workload Identity service account: no keys exist anywhere

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: AI agent: a Job labelled mcp-client. Gets a token (agent-viewer or agent-operator), asks the gateway what it may use, lets Gemini choose tools. It cannot reach the servers; its only Google role is Vertex AI.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Out of scope: gateway rate limits and tracing · TLS public entry point · Keycloak on a persistent database · human login (auth code + PKCE) · image scanning/signing and CI.
